text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills edged down to 45.31 percent from 47.86 percent at the previous sale on January 14, a central bank statement said on Thursday.
The results of Wednesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 13.25 million UAH 32.68 million UAH
Actual amount raised 11.90 million UAH 29.19 million UAH
The central bank sold 132,503 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 111,297 were competitive and 21,206 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is not yet fixed.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills slipped to 60.07 percent from 60.69 at the previous sale on January 14, a central bank statement said.
The results of Wednesday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 16.16 million UAH 43.78 million UAH
Actual amount raised 11.15 million UAH 30.11 million UAH
The central bank sold 161,665 T-bills, the statement said. Of those, 150,593 were competitive and 11,072 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is not yet fixed.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills slipped to 60.50 against 60.78 percent at the previous sale on January 14, a central bank statement said.
The results of Wednesday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 9,910 T-bills, the statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is not yet fixed.
The auction of six-month treasury bills scheduled for January 15 was cancelled without explanation, a central bank statement said.
